title: 第四章 罗峰的实力
slug: 吞噬星空全本免费-吞噬星空最新章节列表
content_zh:
傍晚六点左右，这时候，天已经快完全黑了。
“这份家教工作，也要暂时结束了。”罗峰仿佛一头豹子，灵活迅速得穿梭在小巷当中，前面是一个死胡同，可是罗峰却是整个人一跃，直接腾空超过两米，左手轻轻搭在墙头上，略微一用力，整个人便到了另外一个巷子中。
飞奔前进，也算是家教前的热身。
此时罗峰的速度，保持在一秒钟15米，也就是时速54公里。这样的速度，并非罗峰的极限速度，可是也能做到热身效果了。
呼！呼！
“还有一个月就高考，暂时就停止家教了。这大半年时间家教，也赚了两万块。”也是去年刚刚获得‘高级学员’称号，拥有了这个称号，自己才容易的找到了一份家教工作，教导一个少年基础身法。
薪水是一个小时100块。
每个星期，教五天，每天都是晚上一个小时。也就是说，一个月薪水大概在2000多点。
“爸爸他辛苦工作一天，一个月工资也就两三千。我只是做家教一个小时，就比爸他高这么多……这就是普通人，和武馆高级学员的差别！而如果我能成为‘武者’，差别将大的惊人。”罗峰双眸一凝，前面巷子里，正有一货车在掉头，堵住了路。
不过罗峰并没有减速，奔跑中的他突然一蹬地，跃起两三米高，而后在巷子的墙头上连踏了两步，而后飞跃而下，继续飞速前进。
片刻后——
罗峰已经奔跑到一座幽静的住宅小区外。
“这，才是爸妈他们应该呆的地方。”罗峰停了下来，看着眼前幽静的住宅小区，这个小区的住宅密度比较低，里面有人工水池，也有大量的花草树木点缀，就算是高层住宅，每一层都有空中花园。
除了高层住宅外，还有联排别墅。
要知道——
现如今，华夏国一共六大基地，也就是六大市！每一个市人口都很惊人，如江南市就近两亿人口。自然而然，土地是非常稀少的，像‘叠加别墅’‘联排别墅’都很稀少，价格很昂贵。而占地更奢侈的‘独栋别墅’更是要缴纳巨额奢侈税的。
“我去18栋1801号。”站在小区门口，罗峰对着小区保安说道。
“等一下。”小区保安按了一下可视电话号码，顿时旁边的摄像头对准了罗峰，可视电话中传来1801号业主声音，“是小罗，放他进来。”
“好的，先生。”小区保安立即放行。
一个小时之后，罗峰走出了小区。

“嗯，家教结束了，去武馆看看，看看我最近实力有没有提升。”
※※※※※※
极限武馆，地球上第一大武馆，由世界第一强者‘洪’创立。
各个武馆，遍布全球各地。
“滴！”在武馆正门口刷了一下学员证，罗峰进入了武馆院内。
一座极限武馆，就仿佛一头巨大的怪兽盘踞在那，论占地面积，比一所高中学校还要大。武馆的正门，足以让十辆轿车并行进入。武馆院内，就是三栋通体银白色的巨型建筑，造型仿佛三艘飞船。
“师兄！”
“师兄好。”
武馆院内的路上，草坪上，有着大量的武馆学员。这些学员们看到罗峰胸前挂着的高级学员证，一个个立即尊敬的很。
武馆内，三栋巨型建筑，分别是初级学员教学楼、中级学员教学楼，以及高级学员教学楼。
其中，高级学员教学楼的一楼、二楼，都是大型教学厅，每一个大型教学厅，都足以容纳数千人。武馆的教员老师，都是在这大型教学厅进行授课。整个极限武馆的学员，大概有三四万之多。
16周岁，才可以成为武馆学员来学习，30周岁后，就禁止再来武馆学习，占用教学资源。
整个武馆的高级学员，一共人数百号人。大多都是二十多岁。
而罗峰，才年仅18周岁。
“师兄好。”
罗峰一路听着恭敬的喊声，进入高级学员教学楼的三楼，这里才是高级学员才能进入的地方。
三楼，足有百米长宽的大型练武厅，此时有十几人。
“疯子。”
“疯子，来啦。”
一进入这大型练武厅，这十几名高级学员都热情打招呼。

“王哥，杨哥，李姐。”罗峰笑着喊道，看着这一群大哥大姐，心中也觉得暖暖的。这十几个人，年龄都超过了二十岁，罗峰自然是最小的一个。当然，宜安区极限武馆的‘高级学员’不止这十几人，总的高级学员是超过百名的。可是一般没有老师教课，大多数人是懒得来的。

content_en:
It was around six o'clock in the evening. By this time, it was almost completely dark.
"This tutoring job is about to end for the time being." Luo Feng was like a leopard, moving nimbly and quickly through the alleys. There was a dead end in front of him, but Luo Feng jumped up and flew more than two meters in the air. He put his left hand lightly on the wall, and with a slight exertion, he arrived in another alley.
Running forward can be regarded as a warm-up before tutoring.
At this time, Luo Feng's speed was maintained at 15 meters per second, which is 54 kilometers per hour. This speed is not Luo Feng's ultimate speed, but it can also achieve a warm-up effect.
call! call!
"The college entrance examination is in one month, so I have stopped tutoring for the time being. In the past half year, I have earned 20,000 yuan as a tutor." He also just received the title of 'senior student' last year. With this title, he easily found a tutoring job, teaching a teenager basic body movements.
The salary is 100 yuan an hour.
I teach five days a week, one hour each day in the evening. In other words, the monthly salary is probably more than 2,000 points.
"Dad works hard all day, and his monthly salary is only two to three thousand. I only work as a tutor for an hour, and I am already so much higher than dad... This is the difference between ordinary people and senior martial arts students! And if I can become a 'martial artist', the difference will be astonishing." Luo Feng's eyes narrowed. In the alley ahead, a truck was making a U-turn, blocking the road.
However, Luo Feng did not slow down. As he was running, he suddenly kicked off the ground and jumped two to three meters high. Then he took two steps on the wall of the alley, then leaped down and continued to move forward rapidly.
After a while——
Luo Feng had already run outside a quiet residential area.
"This is where parents should stay." Luo Feng stopped and looked at the quiet residential area in front of him. The residential density in this area is relatively low. There are artificial pools and a large number of flowers, plants and trees. Even in high-rise residences, there are sky gardens on every floor.
In addition to high-rise residences, there are also townhouses.
To know——
Nowadays, China has a total of six major bases, that is, six major cities! The population of each city is astonishing. For example, Jiangnan City has a population of nearly 200 million. Naturally, land is very scarce, and properties like 'stacked villas' and 'townhouses' are rare and very expensive. And the 'detached villas' with more luxurious land will have to pay a huge luxury tax.
"I'm going to No. 1801, Building 18." Standing at the gate of the community, Luo Feng said to the community security guard.
"Wait a minute." The community security guard pressed the video phone number, and immediately the camera next to him was focused on Luo Feng. The voice of owner No. 1801 came from the video phone, "It's Ronaldinho, let him in."
"Okay, sir." The community security guard immediately let him go.
An hour later, Luo Feng walked out of the community.
"Well, the tutoring is over. Let's go to the martial arts gym to see if my strength has improved recently."
※※※※※※
Extreme Martial Arts Gym, the largest martial arts gym on earth, was founded by the world’s strongest man ‘Hong’.
Various martial arts schools are located all over the world.
"Bit!" Luo Feng swiped his student ID card at the main entrance of the martial arts hall and entered the martial arts hall.
An extreme martial arts gym is like a huge monster entrenched there. In terms of area, it is larger than a high school. The main entrance of the martial arts hall is large enough for ten cars to enter in parallel. In the courtyard of the martial arts hall, there are three huge silver-white buildings, shaped like three spaceships.
"Brother!"
"Hello, senior brother."
On the road inside the martial arts hall, there are a large number of martial arts students on the lawn. When these students saw the senior student certificate hanging on Luo Feng's chest, they all immediately respected him.
In the martial arts hall, there are three huge buildings, namely the teaching building for junior students, the teaching building for intermediate students, and the teaching building for advanced students.
Among them, the first and second floors of the advanced student teaching building areThey are all large teaching halls, each large enough to accommodate thousands of people. The teachers and teachers of the martial arts school all teach in this large teaching hall. There are approximately 30,000 to 40,000 students in the entire extreme martial arts gym.
Only when you are 16 years old can you become a martial arts student and study. After you are 30 years old, you are prohibited from coming to the martial arts gym to study and occupy teaching resources.
There are hundreds of senior students in the entire martial arts hall. Most are in their twenties.
And Luo Feng is only 18 years old.
"Hello, senior brother."
Luo Feng listened to the respectful shouts all the way and entered the third floor of the advanced student teaching building. This is where only advanced students can enter.
On the third floor, there is a large martial arts training hall with a length of 100 meters and a width of more than a dozen people.
"Madman."
"Madman, here we come."
As soon as they entered this large martial arts training hall, the dozen or so senior students all greeted them warmly.
"Brother Wang, Brother Yang, Sister Li." Luo Feng shouted with a smile. Looking at this group of brothers and sisters, he felt warm in his heart. These dozen people are all over twenty years old, and Luo Feng is naturally the youngest. Of course, there are more than a dozen 'senior students' at the Yi'an District Extreme Martial Arts Gym. The total number of senior students is over a hundred. But there are generally no teachers to teach, and most people are too lazy to come.
